test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Keep someone at arm’s length

options.text: Restrict someone to a small space to stand
Allow someone to talk only from a distance

solution:
The correct answer is '**Avoid being friendly with someone**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An idiom is a saying or expression that is widely used among speakers of a certain language and whose figurative meaning is different from its literal meaning. 

 
 
• For eg.- the brains behind - used to refer to the person who originally invented a particular scheme, plan, or idea.
 
 
 
• The idiom ‘keep someone at arm's length’ means to avoid being very close to or friendly with someone or something.
 
• Hence, option 4 i.e. keep someone at arm's length is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Figurative**: departing from a literal use of words or metaphorical.

 
 
• **For eg.-** He's my son, in the **figurative** sense of the word.
